mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher consumer spending and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where GDP growth exceeds 3% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, and ultimately resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where the federal funds rate exceeds 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with increasing payroll employment, indicates a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where the unemployment rate is below 4% and payroll employment exceeds 150000.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, combined with a decrease in housing starts, indicates a shift in the supply curve, leading to increased prices and decreased demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where industrial production exceeds 105 and housing starts are below 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales indicates increased consumer spending, which leads to higher demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where retail sales growth exceeds 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 2% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to increased borrowing and spending, and ultimately resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where the federal funds rate is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate, combined with decreasing payroll employment, indicates a weak labor market, which leads to decreased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances where the unemployment rate exceeds 6% and payroll employment is below 140000.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, combined with an increase in housing starts, indicates a strong supply response, leading to increased production and decreased prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where industrial production exceeds 110 and housing starts are above 1200.
